svg.text: Honda Insight G1 · all taps at the EPS control unit (behind the right kick panel) · matches BOM.md v2 · resistor values shown at the probe are fitted at the back-probe end of each lead
logger GND star point — every ⏚ on this sheet connects here
HSTS016L ±50 A clamp, GRN wire only
sensor +5 V ← Feather USB pin · sensor GND ← logger GND (same cable)
Not tapped: B1 Vcc1 (optional) · B12 n/c
NEVER: B3 SCS · B5 DIAG-H · B7 SG (shield)
NEVER electrically: A3 M+ · A4 PG
microSD CS = D10, RTC on I2C
blip every 2 s — waiting for key
⏚ = logger GND. It reaches the car only through the 100 Ω lead to B9 (T/S GND), so the EPS motor’s 40 A return can’t form a ground loop through the logger.
Analog taps see ≥ 2.8 MΩ (multimeter-class load). U1 runs from 3V3, so its outputs can’t exceed the ADC range. Digital taps see ≥ 127 kΩ; their pins are INPUT with no internal pull-ups.
Fit back-probes with the ignition OFF and continuity-check neighbouring probes before key-on. Never pierce insulation or unplug the control unit (EPS_PINOUT.md explains why).
